issue.title: Clone SDD sidecars from a local primary checkout before the remote
issue.description: While implementing lazy document sidecar materialization, the approved plan accepted the current cost: ensure_sdd_kind_clone -> ensure_sidecar_sdd_clone clones missing sidecar roles from the recorded remote URL even when a matching local primary checkout already has that sidecar clone. The first @research ref in a fresh workspace therefore pays a full network clone on the launch path, and the same source choice affects sase repo path <role> --ensure plus existing plans/beads workspace prep. Scope: teach sidecar materialization to prefer a verified matching local primary checkout as the clone source or fallback, preserve remote URL normalization and strict failure diagnostics, and cover plans, beads, and custom document sidecars without weakening workspace isolation.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-js — This was discovered while closing the lazy document-sidecar gap in the artifact-reference contract, but the clone-source optimization affects all SDD sidecar materialization rather than only prompt refs.

payload.close_reason: Backlog cut to seven (owner-requested, 2026-08-12): accepted cost, not a defect. Sidecar materialization cloning from the recorded remote instead of a matching local primary checkout is a latency optimization on the first @research ref in a fresh workspace -- the approved lazy-materialization plan explicitly accepted this cost, and the correctness properties it must not break (remote URL normalization, strict failure diagnostics, workspace isolation) make it a medium change for a one-time network clone. Nothing is broken or blocked. Re-file with a +1 if sidecar clone latency actually shows up on the agent launch path in practice.
